entries.text: Ana dug the first trench. Bram sulked.
Raiders came and Cy was hurt. The wall held.
Dov planted corn and chatted about the weather.
Old Tam died in his sleep. Everyone attended the funeral.
Eli stole a pistol from the armory.
The wedding of Ana and Bram. A newborn cried.
A brawl broke out; Cy was shot and bleeding.

reftexts: Ana carved a sleeping dog at Hollow Ridge. The Old Mill burned; Bram and Ana wept.
